summary: Frontend-only regression testing completed on the public URL across desktop (1920/1440), tablet (768), and mobile (390/320). Core interactions worked (hero slider, menu, modal, review controls, toast flows, image loading, and static-runtime checks), but reveal animation behavior leaves multiple sections hidden after full-page scrolling.

ui_bugs.issue: Multiple content blocks remain hidden (opacity 0) after full stepped scrolling, causing visible blank spaces between sections, especially on 320x800.

integration_issues.issue: Intermittent same-origin request failures observed for Cloudflare challenge/rum endpoints (net::ERR_ABORTED). Core business assets still loaded (24/24 images).

issues: Large blank vertical gaps are visible when reveal-target sections remain hidden.

action_items: Fix IntersectionObserver reveal logic so every .reveal target transitions to .is-revealed reliably across all viewport sizes, including small mobile heights.
Re-verify no section remains opacity:0 after full user scroll through page.
Review Cloudflare challenge/rum abort behavior in preview environment and ensure no required same-origin resources can fail silently.
critical_code_review_comments: Current reveal implementation can leave key sections hidden even after user scroll progression; this is a user-visible content availability defect.
Reveal animation state depends heavily on observer timing/threshold and should include a safe fallback to prevent permanent hidden content.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated against https://golden-chariot-home.preview.emergentagent.com. Confirmed: hero autoplay/dots, responsive review dot counts (desktop=2, tablet/mobile=4), modal required validity, mobile drawer Escape-close, newsletter and quote demo toasts, no React/framework runtime, no broken images. Blocking issue remains in reveal system where many .reveal elements stay hidden after full scroll on mobile. MOCKED flows remain: quote submit, newsletter submit, and review content.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open mobile 320x800, scroll through page from top to bottom in steps, then inspect '.reveal:not(.is-revealed)' and computed styles. Observed many targets still at opacity 0 under '.js-reveal-ready', producing blank gaps. Likely cause: IntersectionObserver threshold/rootMargin + rapid scroll/viewport constraints can miss reveal intersections without fallback mark-as-revealed logic.
